items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So we found Tom and he was the only black policeman... he heard of the band and you all are going to play here tonight

ctx.x: Naturally we were headed on our way then to Enid, where we were going and as he was saying, it started sleeting and it got pretty cold the further we got on, so when we got into Enid a little before day, I reckon around about four o'clock or something like that,

or five, everybody was asleep and we asked a policeman--we finally ran into a policeman and we asked him where was a colored hotel, and of course he said he didn't know, he didn't know if they had any, but they had a colored policeman here. He said go down in that area and he explained just where to go, he said his name was Tom, he can explain to you where to go and where you can get lodging.

So we found Tom and he was the only black policeman, just a little token, so when we found him and asked him where there was a rooming house, he said we don't have that here and he went on and talked, he heard of the band and you all are going to play here tonight; we told him yes.
